mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 60 degree temperatures and clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona Water Utility is partnering with experts to perform mandatory cross connection inspections to prevent water contamination, and residents are reminded to watch for their notification letters. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding meetings regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather feedback on new design concepts.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run, the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event, and more live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report covering October 18 through 24, officers noted that on October 25, a driver was arrested for an O W I offence after being found unresponsive in their vehicle.
You can enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day, Oreo Reese's Cheesecake, while the store is open until 10 PM tonight.
